claimBoundary: These groups create neutral, source-bound A/B review candidates. Model identity and deterministic checks do not label a winner.

groups.title: Programming Decisions and Iteration
groups.courseBrief: Programming Decisions and Iteration, a six-session introductory Python workshop in which students trace short programs, explain state changes, and choose control-flow structures for concrete problems.

groups.title: Python Data Structures and Modular Programs
groups.courseBrief: Python Data Structures and Modular Programs, a six-session laboratory course in which students decompose small programs into functions and choose lists or dictionaries to represent and transform labeled data.

groups.title: Igneous and Volcanic Processes
groups.courseBrief: Igneous and Volcanic Processes, a six-session undergraduate geology module using mineral evidence, magma composition, cooling history, and hazard observations to explain rock textures and eruption styles.

groups.title: Plate Tectonics and Seismology
groups.courseBrief: Plate Tectonics and Seismology, a six-session field-data laboratory in which students interpret Earth structure, plate-boundary motion, and seismic-wave evidence to explain observed geologic hazards.

groups.title: Music Notation and Ear Training
groups.courseBrief: Music Notation and Ear Training, a six-session college musicianship module in which students connect written pitch, interval relationships, and scale patterns to short listening and notation decisions.

groups.title: Harmony and Formal Analysis
groups.courseBrief: Harmony and Formal Analysis, a six-session introductory theory module in which students identify chord construction, explain harmonic motion, and use sectional evidence to describe musical form.

groups.title: UX Research and Synthesis Studio
groups.courseBrief: UX Research and Synthesis Studio, a six-session project course in which students plan ethical studies, distinguish evidence from assumptions, and synthesize observations into personas and journey maps that inform decisions.

groups.title: Prototyping, Task Flow, and Accessibility
groups.courseBrief: Prototyping, Task Flow, and Accessibility, a six-session applied UX laboratory in which students diagram task decisions, build testable interactions, and combine conformance checks with observed user performance.
